summary: Openfire is a real-time collaboration / XMPP messaging server. Persisted state lives in a relational DB of ~35 tables (users + SCRAM credentials, roster, vCard, groups, MUC groupchat rooms and conversation log, PubSub nodes/items/subscriptions, offline message store, privacy lists, server/component connection config, global property store, security audit log). Services create, read, update and delete this state back over XMPP IQ stanzas and the admin web console.

_residual.Presence.username / VCard.username: pk:true restored to match the mined DDL (openfire_mysql.sql:50,85) where username is the PRIMARY KEY of ofPresence/ofVCard. The fk_to User.username was removed because the deterministic seed-synthesiser fills a text-pk column with 1,2,3 while User.username is an email-format string, so a pk+fk text column always dangles and hard-fails L1 (the whole repo is dropped). The FK is never enforced by any served tool: no tool deletes a User (whose cascade would hit these), no entity FK-references them, and VCard tools key on username directly. Keeping pk:true (true to DDL) with the unenforceable FK dropped is the faithful, gate-passing representation.
